records.title: 10-K
records.text: For the year ended December 31, 2020, consolidated revenue was $6.7 billion, a decrease of $0.5 billion or 6.3%, as compared to the prior year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Bookings decreased 4.4% over the prior year to $6.9 billion for the year ended December 31, 2020.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Backlog as of December 31, 2020 was $1.8 billion, up from $1.5 billion from the prior year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Overall, customer pricing favorably impacted revenue by approximately 0.7% for the year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: For the year ended December 31, 2019, other income increased compared to 2018 primarily due to increased earnings from our equity method investments and reduction of non-operating losses from our defined benefit and post-retirement benefit plans.
